source_data: Original local paired GRAB data; exported 8000 original validation and 16000 training frames per hand, plus input moments and original 200-epoch curves.
primary_finding: Strong evidence of mapping input distribution mismatch in the current policy domain, rather than a runtime indexing/scaling/URDF error or a large in-distribution train/validation gap.
important_correction: Prior fresh-DexPilot discrepancies are not original heldout errors. Fresh reference optimization also differs from original sequential labels; those discrepancies should not be attributed entirely to network fitting.
next_step_recommendation: Prioritize a separately versioned mapping dataset with representative policy-domain and smooth PCA-range sequences, retaining original GRAB samples. Hold out complete generated sequences, compare original holdout and policy-domain performance before replacing weights. Do not change official simulation, reward or action bounds.
limitations: Frame-random original split can share adjacent frames.
Coverage metrics are diagnostic, not a hard proof that every policy input is outside dataset support.
No new mapping or PPO training was launched.
